title: Nonlinear stability of 3D Couette flow on $\mathbb T\times\mathbb R^2$ under critical transverse low-frequency control
summary: We establish nonlinear stability of three-dimensional Couette flow for the incompressible Navier--Stokes equations on $\mathbb T\times\mathbb R^2$. Divergence-free perturbations satisfying $\|u_{\rm in}\|_{H^2}+\|u^\perp_{0,\rm in}\|_{\dot B^{-2}_{2,\infty}}\leq c_*ν$ generate unique global $H^2$ solutions that remain close to Couette flow, where $u^\perp_{0,\rm in}$ denotes the streamwise average of the transverse velocity.
